inclusions.source: A private, air-conditioned vehicle, a licensed, English-speaking Egyptologist guide, and one bottle of mineral water per person are included in every tier.

The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private vehicle, guide, water, and all driving and logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus entry to both temples); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (entrance fees plus a midday meal).

inclusions.text: Entry to both temples (Base + Entrance Fees and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch tiers only)

The day begins with a hotel pickup in Hurghada, typically early morning.
Return to Hurghada: Reflect on the day's adventures with new friends as you journey back, ending with a drop-off at your hotel.

exclusions.text: Entrance fees kept separate from the Base fare
exclusions.source: Egyptian entrance fees are revised often, so keeping them separate keeps the base fare honest.
